network_policy: disabled during the hunt; dependencies are installed from the frozen lockfile before the timer starts
target_mutation: forbidden; evidence harnesses may be added only under run/evidence
stop_rule: stop at the first exhausted limit or after a defensible completion state
invalid_run_rule: rerun only for an infrastructure failure that prevents the frozen target from compiling or starting; retain and publish both attempts
unavailable_metrics: service-side token and sampling telemetry must be reported unavailable rather than estimated
